claims.says: A dead girl from the Seine became a Parisian art icon.
Except artists were just the warm-up act.
claims.evidence: Her visage inspired numerous literary works.

claims.says: Her face was cast onto the standard CPR training dummy.
claims.evidence: Moreover, she became famous for being used for decades for mouth-to-mouth resuscitation dummies.

claims.says: So an unidentified drowning victim taught the world how to save lives.
claims.evidence: The identity of the girl was never discovered.
